requirementChanges: Fleet mode is opt-in per box: HOBO_FLEET_AUTHORITY_URL composes the member (roles DISPATCHER and EXECUTOR, DEDICATED). In fleet mode the daemon's legacy GitHub poller is off, so GitHub's queue reaches the box only as github-actions-job fleet work; without it the box polls GitHub alone, with no claim gate (the mesh's turn-taking is gone).

S1 flags on every container the worker starts (docker create and image probes): --cap-drop=ALL, --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true, --pids-limit (default 4096), --read-only, tmpfs /tmp (exec, nosuid, nodev), and anonymous container-owned volumes for /opt/actions-runner and /home/runner so the runner can still write inside its image. Docker's default seccomp profile is kept (never unconfined). No crun, runc, podman or nsenter is named or required.

Deviation kept from S1's 'no host mounts except a read-only source cache': the existing read-write bind mounts of the lease's own job directory and the shared pnpm store stay, because storage admission and hardlinked installs depend on them; the git mirror stays read-only. CPU is left to cpu-shares (no --cpus) on the legacy path.

The host Docker socket is off by default and mounted only while hostDockerAllowed(fleet record, device class) holds (fleet allow_host_docker and a DEDICATED device), read from the registry every 10 s. HOBO_CI_MOUNT_DOCKER_SOCKET no longer exists.

Absorb-slot arithmetic reads FleetCapacity from the registry's signed fleet view: peer slots = fleet free_slots minus this box's own free hobo slots, zero when no view is known. It lives in src/peer-capacity.ts with Peer* names because the fleet vocabulary check (rule 9) refuses fleet-prefixed exports outside the fleet packages; FleetDaemonOptions is BoxMemberOptions for the same reason. Log fields arcFreeSlots/meshFreeSlots became fleetFreeSlots.
HOBO_CI_FLEET_CAPACITY_VOLATILITY_MB is renamed HOBO_CI_WORKER_MEMORY_VOLATILITY_MB so L22's retired-variable grep finds nothing in this package's sources.

readme:
## The box worker as a HoBo Fleet member (L34)

With `HOBO_FLEET_AUTHORITY_URL` set, `scripts/isolated-worker-daemon.mts` composes `createFleetAgent` (`composeFleetDaemon`, `src/fleet-daemon.ts`) as a `DEDICATED` member with roles `DISPATCHER` and `EXECUTOR`:

| Part | Source |
|---|---|
| Capacity | The worker's admission (`capacityFromAdmission`): no free slot unless memory, storage and host health all admit; `DRAINING` while it drains, `PRESSURED` under host pressure |
| Work kind | `github-actions-job` (L16) with `createJitRegistrationMinter`; the daemon's own poller is off in fleet mode |
| Sandboxes | `sandboxDrivers` of `@hobo/fleet-agent` (gVisor `runsc` provisioned by the agent, D58) |
| Egress | `createEgressProxyFactory`, allowlist from the fleet policy |
| Bus | `createNatsBusConnector` of `@hobo/fleet-nats` |

First start enrolls with the bootstrap token in `HOBO_FLEET_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE`; later starts reuse the key store in `HOBO_FLEET_HOME` (default beside the journal). Also: `HOBO_FLEET_NAME`, `HOBO_FLEET_TENANT`, `HOBO_FLEET_REGION`, optional `HOBO_FLEET_MEMBER_NAME`.

Every container the worker starts (`createCliDockerDriver`) is hardened per S1 (`src/isolated-worker/container-flags.ts`): all capabilities dropped, `no-new-privileges`, a pids limit, a read-only root with a tmpfs `/tmp` and container-owned volumes for the runner's directories. The host Docker socket is mounted only while the fleet sets `allow_host_docker` and the box is `DEDICATED`. Trunk release and unlaunched-reservation release count peer slots from the fleet view's `FleetCapacity` (`src/peer-capacity.ts`).

The relay mesh, the published `HOBO_CI_FLEET_*` variables and the local runner are gone; a developer machine is a `PERSONAL` member running `hobo fleet run` (see `LOCAL-DEVELOPMENT.md`).
